sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_sources" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "village_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NULL, "lon" REAL NULL, "location_accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "households_served" INTEGER NULL, "functional_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'functional', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("village_id", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "test_sessions" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES water_sources (id), "calibration_id" TEXT NULL, "tester_profile_id" TEXT NULL, "reference_standard_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "calibrated" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("calibrated" IN (0, 1)), "lat" REAL NULL, "lon" REAL NULL, "location_accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "distance_from_source_m" REAL NULL, "distance_override_reason" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "tested_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER test_sessions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON test_sessions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'test_sessions are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER test_sessions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id, source_id, calibration_id, tester_profile_id, reference_standard_id, calibrated, lat, lon, location_accuracy_m, distance_from_source_m, distance_override_reason, notes, tested_at_device, installation_id, collector_key, collector_snapshot ON test_sessions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'test_sessions are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "test_results" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES test_sessions (id), "overall" TEXT NOT NULL, "standard_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "computed_by" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'device', "retest_of" TEXT NULL, "amendment_of" TEXT NULL, "amendment_reason" TEXT NULL, "flags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "limitation_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER test_results_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON test_results BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'test_results are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER test_results_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id, session_id, overall, standard_id, computed_by, retest_of, amendment_of, amendment_reason, flags, limitation_code, created_at_device ON test_results BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'test_results are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "readings" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES test_sessions (id), "result_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES test_results (id), "parameter_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, "detected" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("detected" IN (0, 1)), "acceptable" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("acceptable" IN (0, 1)), "value_text" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_derived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_derived" IN (0, 1)), "source_device" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER readings_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON readings BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'readings are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER readings_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id, session_id, result_id, parameter_code, value, detected, acceptable, value_text, unit, result, is_derived, source_device ON readings BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'readings are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calibrations" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tester_serial" TEXT NULL, "tester_profile_id" TEXT NULL, "reference_standard_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "buffers" TEXT NULL, "passed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("passed" IN (0, 1)), "performed_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER calibrations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON calibrations BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'calibrations are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER calibrations_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id, tester_serial, tester_profile_id, reference_standard_id, buffers, passed, performed_at_device, installation_id, collector_key, collector_snapshot ON calibrations BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'calibrations are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alerts" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES water_sources (id), "trigger_result_id" TEXT NULL, "trigger_rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "severity" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "opened_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "acknowledged_at" TEXT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "linked_alert_id" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("trigger_result_id", "trigger_rule"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alert_events" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alert_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES alerts (id), "actor_id" TEXT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER alert_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON alert_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'alert_events are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER alert_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id, alert_id, actor_id, event_type, note, occurred_at_device, installation_id, collector_key, collector_snapshot ON alert_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'alert_events are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sanitary_inspections" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES water_sources (id), "answers" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspected_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER sanitary_inspections_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON sanitary_inspections BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'sanitary_inspections are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER sanitary_inspections_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id, source_id, answers, inspected_at_device, installation_id, collector_key, collector_snapshot ON sanitary_inspections BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'sanitary_inspections are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER water_sources_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON water_sources BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'water_sources are deactivated, never deleted');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "admin_units" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES admin_units (id), "pcode" TEXT NULL, "center_lat" REAL NULL, "center_lon" REAL NULL, "default_standard_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parameter_categories" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parameter_definitions" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parameter_categories (code), "default_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_core" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_core" IN (0, 1)), "display_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "plausible_min" TEXT NULL, "plausible_max" TEXT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "scope_admin_unit_id" TEXT NULL, "review_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved', PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tester_profiles" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "tds_factor" TEXT NULL, "parameters" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reference_profiles" ("installation_id" TEXT NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NULL, "collector_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "based_on_id" TEXT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "custom_reason" TEXT NULL, "is_provisional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_provisional" IN (0, 1)), "published_at" TEXT NULL, "document" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "response_cards" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger_rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "audience" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "responsibilities" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "config_documents" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "document" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "seed_imports" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collector_profiles" ("collector_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "collector_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "village" TEXT NOT NULL, "parish" TEXT NOT NULL, "subcounty" TEXT NOT NULL, "district" TEXT NOT NULL, "organisation" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("collector_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "classifications" ("result_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "standard_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "computed_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "overall" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading_results" TEXT NOT NULL, "flags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "computed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("result_id", "standard_id", "computed_by"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "object_key" TEXT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collector_marks" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "collector_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "marked_by" TEXT NULL, "marked_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("collector_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "submission_flags" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "flagged_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at_device" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("stream" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_success_at" TEXT NULL, "cursor_token" TEXT NULL, "failures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("stream"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_locks" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachment_queue" ("attachment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes_sent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', PRIMARY KEY ("attachment_id"));
